values: Select a shielded 2.2 uH power inductor. Recommended Isat >= 1.5 A, Irms >= 1.2 A, DCR <= 150 mOhm. Absolute practical minimum: Isat >= 1.1 A and Irms >= 0.9 A. Prefer a 2016, 2520, or 3030 package instead of the current 1608 footprint.

KiCad priority for an nRF5340 + nRF7002 solution: 1) Fanstel WT02C40C — preferred because this project already contains its KiCad symbol and footprint. 2) Raytac AN02U53U / AN02C53C — manufacturer Altium/Protel footprints and 2D/3D drawings are available for conversion and verification. 3) MinewSemi ME16WS03 — no native KiCad library was found; create and verify the footprint from the mechanical drawing. Bare nRF5340 + nRF7002 ICs have a community KiCad library, but require the full Nordic RF and power reference layout.
